messages:
Maria Gomez: Hey docs team — I put together a slimline tenant onboarding example for Dedicated capacity. It's focused on reserved pools + burst policy and shows a minimal Terraform + SDK snippet. PTAL: https://git.re/redwood/docs/pull/4822 :eyes:

Alex Chen: Nice. Can we make the Terraform snippet show tenant labels + isolation decorator? Keep it minimal tho.

Maria Gomez: Yep. Current snippet:

```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "tenant_pool" {
  name = "tenant-${var.tenant_id}"
  gpus = 4
  labels = { team = var.team }
  isolation = "tenant"
  burst_capacity = 2
}
```

Alex Chen: Might be worth adding the autoscale policy example (policy: cpu-based quickscale) — 1-2 lines.

Raj Patel: Also add tiny SDK example for the JS client showing how to request pinned model + pre-warming connector. Something like:

```js
const res = await redwood.dedicated.createInstance({
  tenantId: "acct_123",
  pool: "tenant-pool",
  model: "redwood-3b",
  prewarm: true
});
```

Sophie Liu: For SLAs we should call out eviction behavior clearly. One-liner: "Reserved pools provide throughput SLO; eviction only occurs under cluster-wide emergency preemption — see eviction matrix link." Add link to internal playbook.

Maria Gomez: Good call. I'll add a small table in the doc (inline) and a footnote linking the eviction matrix. Also will add a line about prefix/KV cache being per-tenant when isolation=tenant.

Jordan (docs-bot): Reminder: new doc pages must include SDK snippet tests in /infra/docs-tests. See checklist: https://git.re/redwood/docs/.github/ISSUE-42

Alex Chen: PR link pls when ready and assign to @raj for SDK review and @sophie for SLA wording.

Maria Gomez: Draft PR here: https://git.re/redwood/docs/pull/4822/files — still TODO: a11y check, one more sample manifest for burst policy YAML.

Raj Patel: Quick nit — in the JS example use `createDedicatedInstance` (recent API rename). Also show token scoping:

```js
const rw = new Redwood({ token: process.env.RW_TOKEN, scope: "dedicated:write" });
await rw.dedicated.createDedicatedInstance({ tenantId: "...", pool: "..." });
```

Sophie Liu: For the SLA sentence, how about: "Reserved capacity is backed by an SLA for average 95th-pct throughput; preemption events are logged and customers get an incident ticket within 15m." Short and specific.

Maria Gomez: Love it. I'll use that wording. Anyone want to take the YAML example?

Alex Chen: I can author a compact YAML for burst policy tonight. Will push to the branch.

Sophie Liu: One more link fix — the "isolation decorators" doc moved. Replace with https://git.re/redwood/docs/isolation-decorators/v2

Maria Gomez: Thanks. I will update links & ping reviewers. Will also add test snippet to infra tests as Jordan requested.

Raj Patel: LGTM for SDK changes after Alex updates JS call. Will review PR tomorrow.

Alex Chen: pushed YAML sample -> https://git.re/redwood/docs/pull/4822/files#diff-abc123

Maria Gomez: Thanks all :tada: I'll merge when we have approvals.
